question_bank.stem: The reward model in RLHF is trained as a separate model to predict what human-centered signal?

options.text: The next token in the original web corpus
Which generated response humans prefer
The legal move with the highest Q-table entry
The grayscale pixels of the next video frame

question_bank.rationale: The reward model is trained from human preference comparisons so it can score generated responses as a proxy for human judgment.

distractor_rationales.A: Next-token prediction is pretraining, not reward-model learning.
distractor_rationales.C: Q-table actions belong to value-based RL, not the text reward model.
distractor_rationales.D: Frame prediction is unrelated to RLHF preference modeling.

source_ref.evidence_span: going to train a separate model to predict

frame_evidence.description: Reward model slide shows multiple sampled SFT responses being ranked by a human labeler.

question_bank.stem: To create reward-model training data, the SFT model samples multiple answers and humans perform what operation on them?

options.text: Compute the Bellman target for each token
Convert each answer into a one-hot state vector
Crop the answer to remove irrelevant score pixels
Compare the answers and indicate preferred responses

question_bank.rationale: The slide shows SFT-generated responses sent to a human labeler, who compares or ranks them for preference data.

distractor_rationales.A: Bellman targets are for value updates, not human preference labels.
distractor_rationales.B: One-hot state vectors belong to toy DQN inputs, not preference labeling.
distractor_rationales.C: Cropping score pixels is an Atari preprocessing step.

source_ref.evidence_span: And then you will ask a human labeler

frame_evidence.description: Reward model slide shows multiple sampled SFT responses being ranked by a human labeler.

question_bank.stem: When converting the SFT language model into a reward model, the output head is changed to produce what?

options.text: A scalar value representing reward
A full softmax over the next token
A vector of Q-values for Atari actions
A terminal Boolean for each sentence

question_bank.rationale: The language-model softmax is replaced by a scalar reward head that scores a response for preference alignment.

distractor_rationales.B: That is the original language-model output head, not the reward-model head.
distractor_rationales.C: Atari action Q-values are DQN outputs, not reward-model outputs.
distractor_rationales.D: A terminal Boolean would not express human preference strength.

source_ref.evidence_span: You'll put a scalar value as output.

frame_evidence.description: Reward model slide shows the SFT model with the softmax replaced by a scalar reward head.

question_bank.stem: The reward-model loss pushes the model toward assigning higher reward to what response in a comparison pair?

options.text: The response with the shorter token count
The response sampled with the highest temperature
The response humans preferred
The response generated earliest by the SFT model

question_bank.rationale: The pairwise loss separates preferred from less preferred responses by encouraging a higher reward for the preferred answer.

distractor_rationales.A: Shorter length alone is not the preference signal.
distractor_rationales.B: Sampling temperature is not the target of the preference loss.
distractor_rationales.D: Generation order does not define the preferred response.

source_ref.evidence_span: for the preferred answer and a predicted reward

frame_evidence.description: Reward model slide shows a pairwise preference setup and the reward-model loss separating preferred from less preferred answers.

question_bank.stem: In the RLHF mapping for text generation, a language-model action corresponds to what choice?

options.text: Selecting the next environment state directly
Choosing the next token to generate
Picking the human labeler for the prompt
Cropping the prompt before reward scoring

question_bank.rationale: The lecture maps the policy's action to the next token in a generated sequence, with reward supplied by the reward model after generation.

distractor_rationales.A: The model chooses tokens; the resulting state includes prompt plus generated tokens so far.
distractor_rationales.C: Human labelers create reward-model data earlier and are not actions during RLHF rollout.
distractor_rationales.D: Prompt cropping is not part of the RLHF action definition.

source_ref.evidence_span: And the action is the next token that
